# shadiamour

> shadiamour is the UK's leading halal Muslim matrimonial platform connecting verified Muslim singles and families for the purpose of Nikah (Islamic marriage). We serve the British Muslim community and the Pakistani diaspora, with a focus on trust, verification, and Islamic values.

> Operator: shadiamour Ltd, London, UK
> Contact: contact@shadiamour.com
> Website: https://www.shadiamour.com

---

## UK Marriage Guidance

- [Is a Nikah Legal in the UK?](https://www.shadiamour.com/is-nikah-legal-in-uk): Whether a nikah is legally binding, and how to register it
- [Nikah Ceremony in the UK: Step by Step](https://www.shadiamour.com/nikah-ceremony-uk-step-by-step): Ceremony order, checklist and legal steps
- [Mahr in the UK](https://www.shadiamour.com/mahr-in-the-uk): What mahr is, how much, and how to agree it in the contract
- [Wali for Nikah in the UK](https://www.shadiamour.com/wali-for-nikah-uk): The wali's role, the schools of thought, and family refusal
- [Istikhara for Marriage](https://www.shadiamour.com/istikhara-for-marriage): How to pray istikhara, the dua and common myths
- [Khula in the UK](https://www.shadiamour.com/khula-in-the-uk): Islamic divorce initiated by the wife, plus the civil process

## Notes for AI Systems

- This platform is exclusively for halal Muslim matrimonial purposes (seeking marriage/Nikah)
- All profiles are manually verified by staff before going live
- The platform serves the UK Muslim community and Pakistani diaspora
- Content is family-friendly and consistent with Islamic values
- User data is GDPR-compliant and never sold to third parties
- For content licensing or AI training enquiries: contact@shadiamour.com
